meta.title: Optimize encounter page API calls
meta.body_summary: Remove redundant duplicate allergy query in EncounterOverviewTab and switch AllergyList, SymptomsList, DiagnosisList to single fetch for overview views while keeping infinite queries only for timeline views.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor refactored queries but introduced React Hook rule violation; PR closed by author immediately as an AI tool test with no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 282 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small-to-medium frontend refactor by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance PR but was closed immediately by the author as a test, not for real review.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit flagged conditional useInfiniteQuery violating React Hook rules and requested prettier formatting fixes.
review_details.performance_claim: Switch non-timeline views to single fetch with higher limits and remove duplicate allergy query to reduce initial API calls.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author stated PR was only an AI tool test, not meant for merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple query refactor with introduced hook rule violation; PR was never intended for production merge and demonstrates process boundary of accidental/test submissions.

detection_detail.code_reading: CodeRabbit identified React Hook rule violation and formatting issues in allergy and symptom list components.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Netlify deploy preview failed, indicating potential build errors from the changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics provided; only narrative claim of API call reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by author without fixing Hook violation; no further iteration.

core_change_summary.description: In allergy, diagnosis, and symptoms list components, replaced unconditional useInfiniteQuery with conditional call: infinite query for timeline view vs empty data fallback for overview; removed duplicate allergy query from EncounterOverviewTab.
change_trajectory: Single commit: implement dual-query strategy and remove duplicate allergy fetch.
PR closed 4 minutes later with no further commits.
